versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image Generation — Pro Pack on RunComfy.

- Generate and edit images using 11+ leading AI models through the RunComfy CLI.
- Supports both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image/edit (i2i) workflows.
- Automatically selects the best model based on user intent (e.g. typography, photorealism, speed, brand styling).
- Unified prompting and invocation patterns, with documentation provided for each model.
- Triggers on natural language prompts like "generate image", "make a picture", or explicit creation/restyle requests.
